title: Kobayashi Pseudometric Vanishing on Calabi–Yau Manifolds
exact_target: Does the Kobayashi pseudometric vanish identically on every compact Calabi–Yau manifold? In particular, must every such manifold be Kobayashi non-hyperbolic and contain an entire curve?
